mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_meridian_baseline (id,user_id,baseline_type,meridian_slot_code,baseline_hr,baseline_spo2,baseline_stress,baseline_fatigue,baseline_recovery,confidence_level,confidence_score,effective_at,updated_at) VALUES (CAST((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW(3)) * 1000000 + FLOOR(RAND() * 1000000)) AS UNSIGNED),#{userId},#{baselineType},#{meridianSlotCode},#{baselineHr},#{baselineSpo2},#{baselineStress},#{baselineFatigue},#{baselineRecovery},#{confidenceLevel},#{confidenceScore},NOW(),NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE baseline_hr=VALUES(baseline_hr),baseline_spo2=VALUES(baseline_spo2),baseline_stress=VALUES(baseline_stress),baseline_fatigue=VALUES(baseline_fatigue),baseline_recovery=VALUES(baseline_recovery),confidence_level=VALUES(confidence_level),confidence_score=VALUES(confidence_score),updated_at=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_meridian_baseline WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND baseline_type=#{baselineType} AND meridian_slot_code=#{meridianSlotCode} LIMIT 1
